name: Polka
source: Rpg created by Commodorette. Polka is the second game in the Time Traveler Universe trilogy. In this world, magic and relative unnatural events are the norm. It is a magical world where there are humans, "fairies", creatures similar to dragons, also called Gigas, Demons, Wizards, Sorcerers and finally, Witches. Due to the content of the game, it will be classified for over 16 years as it has sensitive topics such as child abuse, necrophilia, and other sensitive topics that may hurt the sensitivity of the players, and some scenes of gore.
translation: 由Commodorette创建的角色扮演游戏。Polka是《时间旅行者》宇宙三部曲中的第二款游戏。在这个世界上，魔法和相对的非自然事件是常态。这是一个神奇的世界，其中有人类、“仙女”、类似龙的生物，也被称为吉加斯、恶魔、巫师、巫师，最后是女巫。由于游戏内容的原因，该游戏将被分类超过16年，因为它包含虐待儿童、恋尸等敏感话题，以及其他可能伤害玩家敏感度的敏感话题，以及一些血腥场景。
